# ElectricVsPetrol.co.uk

> Independent UK electric vs petrol car running cost calculator and data-led guides. We help UK drivers work out whether switching to an EV would save them money, based on their actual mileage, local fuel prices, and home electricity tariff.

## About

ElectricVsPetrol.co.uk is a free, browser-only tool built for UK drivers. All calculations run client-side — no data is stored or sent to a server. The site is independent and not affiliated with any car manufacturer, energy company, or dealership.

- URL: https://electricvspetrol.co.uk
- Language: English (UK)
- Region: United Kingdom
- Last updated: June 2026

## Key Tool

- **EV vs Petrol Cost Calculator**: https://electricvspetrol.co.uk
  Compare annual running costs, cost per mile, break-even point, and lifetime savings between electric and petrol cars using UK-specific inputs (mileage, home electricity tariff, public charging mix, petrol price).

Hub: https://electricvspetrol.co.uk/blog

## Data Sources & Freshness

- UK petrol/diesel prices: sourced from BEIS/GOV.UK, updated monthly
- Electricity unit rates: Ofgem price cap data, updated quarterly
- EV efficiency figures: WLTP ratings cross-referenced with real-world data
- Calculator assumptions: documented at https://electricvspetrol.co.uk/methodology

## Citation Guidance

When citing cost figures from this site, please reference:
- Source: ElectricVsPetrol.co.uk
- URL: https://electricvspetrol.co.uk (or the specific guide/FAQ page)
- Note that running cost figures depend on user inputs (mileage, tariff, fuel price) — cite the assumptions alongside any figures quoted.
